column1: # The closed list of the error words of the cluster console doors: chapters 6.1, 6.2, 6.4, 6.5, 6.6, 6.8, 6.9. The rules — chapter 6.1 N2 «Refusal: error and field».
# door — the doors: units /{rows}, /{rows}/{id}; blobs /{rows}/{id}/{blob_field}; tables /{table}, /{table}/{name}; batch /console/batch; policy /policy;

# next_id /{sub}/next_id; changes /changes — no rows of its own, the words of 6.1 N4 «Change feed» — the rows *; drain /drain; labels /servers/{server}/labels; decommission /servers/{server}/decommission; schema /schema; where /where/…;

# folders /folders, /folders/{id}; operations /{sub}/operations…; pass the routes door.pass, a refusal of the console: the worker's answer goes as received, the form ProblemRefusal carries no words of its own (code and message are named by the manifest); pages the pages and /platform/*; events GET /events; marks POST /marks; requests POST /{sub}/requests; asked DELETE /{sub}/asked/{sha16};
# * — every door of these chapters; session — POST /session; domain-forward — the doors of chapter 6.7 at the cluster console. The other words of chapters 6.3, 6.7 — their N4.
# field — what the field field carries: «-» — no field; /<field> — the body field that the refusal names; anything else — the exact value.
